content_sections.text: Candidates who are interested in applying for the Government of National Capital Territory of Delhi, Office of the Medical Superintendent, Bhagwan Mahavir Hospital Recruitment 2026 should first download and carefully read the official notification PDF. The notification contains complete details about vacancy distribution, eligibility criteria, age limit, stipend/salary, selection process, important dates, and application instructions. Reading the official document is important to ensure that you meet all requirements before submitting the application form. Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: MBBS Degree from MCI recognized university with internship completion certificate. Registration with Delhi Medical Council is compulsory.

content_sections.heading: Age Limit
content_sections.text: Maximum Age Limit: 40 years. Age relaxation will be provided as per rules for SC/ST, OBC and Physically Handicapped candidates.

content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for Government of National Capital Territory of Delhi, Office of the Medical Superintendent, Bhagwan Mahavir Hospital Junior Resident (M.B.B.S) Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to attend the walk-in interview for the Junior Resident post?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for the Junior Resident (M.B.B.S) post is scheduled for 30th July 2026. Candidates are advised to reach the venue on time.

faq.question: Q2. What is the total number of vacancies for the Junior Resident post?
faq.answer: There are a total of 5 vacancies for the Junior Resident (M.B.B.S) position at Bhagwan Mahavir Hospital.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for the Junior Resident post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess an MBBS Degree from an MCI-recognized university and have completed their internship. Registration with the Delhi Medical Council is mandatory.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the Junior Resident post?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Junior Resident post is 40 years. Age relaxation is applicable for reserved categories as per government rules.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Junior Resident position?
faq.answer: The salary for the Junior Resident post ranges from Rs. 56,100 to Rs. 1,77,500 per month.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the Junior Resident recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process for this recruitment will be based on a Walk-in Interview.

faq.question: Q8. Where is the walk-in interview going to be held?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be held at the Government of National Capital Territory of Delhi, Office of the Medical Superintendent, Bhagwan Mahavir Hospital.

faq.question: Q9. What documents should I carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must carry all original documents and one set of self-attested photocopies, including ID proof, educational certificates, internship completion certificate, and Delhi Medical Council registration.

faq.question: Q10. Is this a regular or ad-hoc appointment?
faq.answer: This is an ad-hoc appointment for the Junior Resident (M.B.B.S) post.
